scheme_name: Financial Assistance for Education for the Construction Workers
state: Dadra and Nagar Haveli and Daman and Diu
other_conditions: Applicant must be a registered member of the Building and Other Construction Workers Welfare Board of the UT
Applicant must have engaged in building or other construction work for at least 90 days in a given year
Beneficiary child must be one of the first two children of the registered member
Member must not have claimed this reimbursement before from any other source and will not claim it in future
Child must be studying in Class 1‑12, Graduation/ITI/Polytechnic/Technical courses, or preparing for competitive exams
For competitive exams, the student must be in Class IX‑XII or have passed Class XII not more than 2 years prior to the claim period
benefits_summary: Provides fee reimbursement for up to two children of registered construction workers, covering school tuition, higher‑education courses and up to 75% of competitive‑exam fees (maximum ₹50,000 per year).
